put.description: Replaces the full list of mitigation actions recorded for the assessment. The RiskAssessment model has no field to record who made a mitigation change, so this endpoint cannot attribute the update to a named actor beyond what request logging captures. If no assessment exists with the given id, the underlying service silently takes no action and this endpoint still returns 204.

204.description: Mitigation actions updated (or id did not match any assessment)

delete.description: Delete an existing ECCN classification record

post.description: Scores a module for export-control risk from restricted end uses (10 pts each), high-risk users (5 pts each), and third-party components (3 pts each). Risk level is LOW (score <= 10), MEDIUM (score <= 30), or HIGH (score > 30). assessmentDate defaults to today and nextReviewDate defaults to six months from today.

409.description: A risk assessment for this module already exists

get.description: Retrieve all ECCN records, optionally filtered by exact category or by a control reason they contain

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by exact category code (e.g. "5")

parameters.name: controlReason
parameters.description: Filter by a control reason contained in the record's control reasons (e.g. "NS")

post.description: Create a new ECCN classification record

post.summary: Suggest an ECCN classification (human review required)
post.description: Runs automated module analysis (AutomatedClassificationToolService) and returns a SUGGESTED ECCN classification for human compliance review only. reviewRequired is always true in the response; this endpoint never finalizes a classification or sets a CLASSIFIED/APPROVED status. KNOWN LIMITATION: the underlying source/package content analysis is a stub (no concrete AI model wiring); encryption-library and payment-processing detection always return empty/false, so the suggested code will typically be a generic fallback (e.g. EAR99) rather than a true content-derived classification.

200.description: Suggestion generated (see description for stub limitations)

post.description: Creates a new compliance document record with type, name, module, ECCN classification, storage location, and creator. Expiration date is not a caller-supplied field: the service always derives a fixed 5-year retention window from the creation date.

get.description: Lists all versions of a document, ordered by version number descending (newest first).

parameters.name: documentId
parameters.description: ID of the document record

post.description: Adds a new content version to an existing document record.

parameters.name: documentId
parameters.description: ID of the document record to add a version to

400.description: Invalid document ID, document not found, or request body failed validation

post.description: Links two existing document records together under an explicit relationship type (e.g. SUPERSEDES, SUPPORTS).

400.description: Either document not found, or request body failed validation

post.description: Generates a placeholder document record from a template name. The underlying service implementation currently ignores the supplied data map and always stores a fixed 'Generated' document type with ECCN 'N/A'.

Explicitly triggers archival of all document records whose expiration date has passed. This is a deliberate, human-initiated action — it is never triggered automatically as a side effect of another operation.

patch.description: Sets nextReviewDate to today plus the given number of months. If no assessment exists with the given id, the underlying service silently takes no action and this endpoint still returns 204.

204.description: Next review date scheduled (or id did not match any assessment)

patch.summary: Flag a risk assessment for follow-up
patch.description: Sets requiresFollowUp to true. This only raises a follow-up flag; it never closes, waives, or auto-resolves a finding. If no assessment exists with the given id, the underlying service silently takes no action and this endpoint still returns 204.

204.description: Follow-up flag set (or id did not match any assessment)

get.description: Filters by exactly one criterion at a time, in this precedence order when more than one is supplied: moduleName, riskLevel, endUse, thirdPartyComponent. Searching by high-risk user, by assessor, or by follow-up flag is not currently supported — the underlying service does not expose those lookups.

parameters.name: moduleName
parameters.description: Exact module name to search for

parameters.name: riskLevel
parameters.description: Risk level to search for (LOW, MEDIUM, or HIGH)

parameters.name: endUse
parameters.description: Restricted end use substring to search for

parameters.name: thirdPartyComponent
parameters.description: Third-party component substring to search for

get.description: Returns every assessment currently scored at HIGH risk level (score > 30).
Returns assessments whose nextReviewDate is before today. The underlying service does not accept an arbitrary as-of date, so only "due as of now" can be queried.

200.description: Assessments due for review returned (possibly empty)

get.description: Checks whether the given code matches the required 5-character ECCN format (numbers and uppercase letters). This is a format check only — it does not confirm the code is a registered classification, and it is not a compliance determination.

200.description: Validation result returned (valid=true, or valid=false with an explanatory message)

get.description: Search ECCN records by query string
Retrieve a single ECCN classification by its commodity code. Backed by EccnService.findByCommodityCode(String); since commodityCode is uniquely indexed, the first match is returned.

400.description: eccnCode does not match the required 5-character ECCN format

404.description: No ECCN record matches the given code

get.description: Retrieve change-history entries for the ECCN matching the given code. KNOWN STUB: EccnService.getEccnHistory currently always returns an empty list, so this endpoint returns [] until history tracking is implemented.

200.description: History entries for the ECCN (currently always empty — see description)

400.description: eccnCode does not match the required 5-character ECCN format

404.description: No ECCN record matches the given code

get.description: Derives the list of distinct category values currently present across all ECCN records. No dedicated repository/service method exists for this; it is computed from EccnService.findAllEccns() results.
Returns a line-by-line diff between two versions of the same document.

parameters.name: documentId
parameters.description: ID of the document record

parameters.name: version1
parameters.description: First version number to compare

parameters.name: version2
parameters.description: Second version number to compare

400.description: Invalid document ID, or either version number not found

get.description: Case-insensitive substring search over document names.

parameters.name: searchTerm
parameters.description: Substring to search for within document names

get.summary: Find documents by creation date range
get.description: Lists document records created between the given start and end dates (inclusive).

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start of the creation date range (ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-01-01)

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End of the creation date range (ISO-8601, e.g. 2026-12-31)

500.description: Unexpected server error, including malformed date parameters

parameters.name: documentType

get.summary: Find documents by type and module
get.description: Lists document records matching both the given document type and associated module.

parameters.name: documentType
parameters.description: Document type, e.g. TECHNICAL_SPECS

parameters.name: moduleName
parameters.description: Associated software module name

get.description: Lists document records associated with the given software module.

get.description: Lists document records associated with the given ECCN classification.

parameters.name: eccnClassification

get.description: Lists document records created by the given username, for audit purposes.

parameters.name: username

delete.description: Explicitly triggers permanent deletion of all document records currently marked archived, per retention policy. This is a deliberate, human-initiated action — it is never triggered automatically as a side effect of another operation. The underlying service does not currently accept scoping parameters (e.g. a specific document ID or date cutoff); it deletes every archived record in one call.

UpdateMitigationActionsRequest.description: Request to replace the mitigation actions recorded against a risk assessment

mitigationActions.description: Full list of mitigation actions to record for this assessment (replaces any existing list)

licenseRequired.description: Indicates if a license is required

deprecated.description: Flag indicating if this ECCN is deprecated

replacementEccnId.description: ID of the ECCN that replaces this one if deprecated

encryptionRelated.description: Flag indicating if this ECCN is encryption related

financialSoftware.description: Flag indicating if this ECCN applies to financial software

dataAnalytics.description: Flag indicating if this ECCN applies to data analytics

analyticsCapabilities.description: List of analytics capabilities if applicable

CreateRiskAssessmentRequest.description: Request to create a new export-control risk assessment for a module

moduleName.description: Name of the module being assessed

restrictedEndUses.description: Restricted end uses identified for this module (each contributes 10 points to the risk score)

highRiskUsers.description: High-risk users identified for this module (each contributes 5 points to the risk score)

thirdPartyComponents.description: Third-party components identified for this module (each contributes 3 points to the risk score)

assessedBy.description: Named human assessor performing this risk assessment

productId.description: Identifier of the product being classified

productName.description: Name of the product/module/package being classified; used as the module name for automated analysis and classification history

description.description: Description of the product. NOTE: not currently analyzed — the underlying analysis methods are stubs that ignore this field.

technicalSpecs.description: Optional free-form technical specifications. NOTE: not currently analyzed — accepted for forward compatibility only.

requestedBy.description: Person or system requesting the classification, retained for audit purposes

priority.description: Requested priority of this classification request

confidence.description: Confidence score for this candidate, between 0.0 and 1.0

id.description: Identifier of the persisted classification-history/analysis record backing this suggestion

eccnCode.description: Suggested ECCN code. WARNING: source/package content analysis is currently a stub (see class Javadoc), so this typically resolves to a generic fallback such as EAR99 rather than a true content-derived classification.

confidence.description: Confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0 from the optional AI suggestion model. 0.0 means either genuinely low confidence or — more likely today — that no AI model (ChatClient) is configured; treat 0.0 as 'unknown' rather than 'zero confidence'.

reasoning.description: Human-readable rationale for the suggested classification, generated from the (stub) module analysis

alternativeClassifications.description: Other candidate ECCN codes with confidence scores, when the AI suggestion model returned more than one candidate. Empty when no AI model is configured.

reviewRequired.description: Always true: this endpoint returns a SUGGESTION for human compliance review only. It never finalizes a classification or sets a CLASSIFIED/APPROVED status.

classifiedAt.description: Timestamp when this suggestion was generated

documentType.description: Type of document, e.g. TECHNICAL_SPECS, CLASSIFICATION_JUSTIFICATION

description.description: Free-text description of the document's contents
description.example: Detailed technical specification supporting ECCN classification

storageLocation.description: Path or reference to the actual stored document

associatedModule.description: Software module or product this document is associated with

createdBy.description: Username or identifier of the record creator

content.description: Full content of the new document version

documentId1.description: ID of the first document record

documentId2.description: ID of the second document record to link to the first

relationshipType.description: Type of relationship between the two documents

templateName.description: Name of the template to generate the document from

data.description: Template data values (currently unused by the underlying service implementation)

ScheduleNextReviewRequest.description: Request to reschedule the next review date of a risk assessment

months.description: Number of months from today until the next review is due

valid.description: True when the supplied code matches the required ECCN format (5 characters, numbers and uppercase letters)

message.description: Human-readable explanation, present when the code is invalid
